property_summary: For every non-empty recipient list and any caller-chosen caddress helper, the reference contract's transfer function always makes each external call with the ERC20 transferFrom(address,address,uint256) selector, so the helper's recorded selector for every call equals keccak256("transferFrom(address,address,uint256)")[:4], whereas the buggy mutant uses keccak256("transfer(address,uint256)")[:4] and violates this universally.
change_summary: Change the call selector to the ERC20 transfer selector instead of transferFrom, changing the callee behavior.
